task_draw_order: for each task in index order: draw the three shifts, then draw radius scale, with default_rng(task_seed)
raw_rng: default_rng(SeedSequence([observation_seed, task_index])), site order then replicate order
retention: same 512-node complete-identity mixture rule at cap362, then keep every unique bank policy as a primary; shared retained fallback and terminal actions for all selectors
prediction_sites: indices4 onward only; first four sites excluded because their first raw records condition the posterior
prediction_metrics: four-head bias/MSE and Gaussian-moment 95-percent interval coverage against scoring truth; replicated heldout f/g exact joint log predictive densities and sample-variance PIT; moment intervals for the identity mixture are not exact mixture quantiles
terminal_metrics: selected conditional expected safe reward/calls, estimation errors and loss to best same-class action; full truth only after all ten decisions are saved
source_fit: existing legacy source_fit_contract, unchanged source-only objective, tolerances, discrepancy floor, group spectral ARD and zero non-intercept coefficient means
source_cost: all eight tasks count once toward new source generation; only tasks0-5 train, first four raw records of tasks6/7 are reused adaptation; no new terminal simulation
scope: two related source-population holdouts, not target-d1000 transfer, physical factor recovery or independent deployment certificates
